levels.title: Nx projects
levels.label: Nx 專案
levels.intro: Each node is an Nx project, labelled with its `type:*` tag. An arrow `a --> b` means project `a` depends on project `b` (from `nx graph`).

levels.title: Backend contexts
levels.label: 後端上下文
levels.intro: Each node is a top-level package of the `cert_prep_backend` Python package, labelled with its bounded context from `.agents/PLANS/ddd-refactor/README.md` (`api` holds the shared HTTP errors and bearer auth, `bootstrap` assembles the app and `entrypoints` start it). An arrow `a --> b` means a module in `a` imports a module in `b` (from grimp); imports inside one package are not drawn. The rules are the import-linter contracts in `apps/cert-prep-backend/pyproject.toml`.

levels.title: UI modules
levels.label: 前端模組
levels.intro: Each node is a Sheriff module (`sheriff.config.ts`) of the Angular app, the Spartan UI libraries, or the generated API client, labelled with its Sheriff tags; `root` holds files outside every module. An arrow `a --> b` means a TypeScript file in `a` imports a file in `b`. Tests and test helpers are not drawn.
